description: React component implementing an admin login and password reset flow for an admin portal. Handles authentication, password reset, and password update UI states.

methods.name: AdminAuth()
methods.description: React functional component for admin authentication and password management UI.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles the sign-in form submission, performs login via signIn() hook, and updates UI based on success or error.

methods.name: submitResetRequest
methods.description: Handles the password reset request, sending a reset email via requestPasswordReset() hook.

methods.name: submitSetNewPassword
methods.description: Handles setting a new password after recovery link, updating password via updatePassword() hook.
